message.content:
Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) along the I‑5 corridor. Under normal conditions—steady traffic, no major detours, and staying within speed limits—you can expect the trip to take around **6 hours**.  

If you’re heading out during rush hour or on a weekend when traffic can be heavier, add an extra hour or two. Conversely, if you’re traveling on a clear day with minimal stops, you might shave off a few minutes. Always check a live navigation app for real‑time traffic updates before you hit the road.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How long will it take to travel from San Francisco to Los Angeles by car?" They want an estimate of travel time. We can provide approximate driving distance (~383 miles via I-5) and typical driving time (~6 hours). But we might also mention traffic, speed limits, etc. There's no function call needed. Just answer.
